name: team_code under a year axis renders the team the player played for that season, not his current team
description: Regression test for a production defect (/u/8507baa7ef36e3f5036ffc54f0d0a05d, 2026-08-22): team_code declares source.grain 'team', whose identity carries no row_axes, so group_tables_by_supported_row_axes intersected the request's ['year'] down to [] and handed the column row_axes: []. get_player_bridge then fell through to the year-less player_teams snapshot (ARRAY[current_nfl_team]), and every year row from 2020 to 2026 rendered the player's CURRENT team -- Stefon Diggs read NE for 2020 through 2024. The fix declares source.supports_row_axes so the column keeps the year axis and routes through the player_years_teams bridge. The seeded rows assert the value, not just the join: a player active in 2021 and traded mid-2022 must read his historical teams, and a player with no 2022 gamelog must read NULL rather than falling back to his current team.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2021,2022]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2021::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2021 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2021 UNION ALL SELECT pgl.pid, 2022::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2022 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2022) src
          GROUP BY pid, year) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, player_years_teams.teams as team_code_0, "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, player_years_teams.teams, "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
